Travel paperwork, an update at dawn
We write to travelers
Travel paperwork and pet safety at Aurelia Skyways

Travelers need to bring the right animal papers and follow the Companion Animal Travel Desk guidance before check-in. That keeps the trip calm for you and comfortable for your companion animal.

Our staff looks over each case with a safety-minded eye, checking carriers, labels, and travel notes so there are no surprises at the airport. <<FACT F067>> Please keep your pet calm, secure, and ready for normal handling by trained staff. If your plans include a reptile, <<FACT F078>> Bring any extra care notes with you, and tell the desk early about special feeding, resting, or comfort needs.

We know travel can feel busy, but a few small checks help a lot. A clean carrier, clear paperwork, and steady supervision make boarding smoother for everyone. If you are traveling with Emil Lee, Ethan Larsen, or Baxter, the same friendly process applies, and the welcome team will help keep things moving in a safe way.

For any pet travel question, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
